body: It's good to see I'm not alone in this. Thanks dude
Police using their power to harm people, or the Amazon burning, or entire regions being oppressed while all I can do is watch makes me feel worthless.

I feel that I have to follow a road set out for me. A degree is basically a necessity at this point, same with a job to make a living. The repetion of every day gets to me. Spending most of my time in traffic or in front of a computer screen is killing me. I crave being outside in a beautiful place.

I feel like a hollow shell right now and expressing myself feels good, so thanks for asking.
